scope: Headed production UI review; this is not an independent output-validation or process-tree memory certification.
method: Playwright CLI, real fixture selection, production workers, test-mode OPFS destination, screenshots visually inspected

completedFlows.settings: 320px cap, 1000 kb/s, 15 fps cap, higher quality

quotaFailure.error: The destination ran out of quota after a bounded write.

defectsFixed: Failed and cancelled jobs displayed Calculating or a stale estimate for remaining time. They now display Not applicable.
A later encoding-control CSS rule suppressed the global keyboard focus outline on selects. The override was removed and every tested dropdown now shows the coral focus outline.

permissionFailureAfterFix.error: Destination permission was revoked after a bounded write.
permissionFailureAfterFix.visualReview: Two-column metrics, complete error message, and retry button readable without horizontal overflow.

mobileVideoControls.visualReview: All five controls, labels, selected values, route, storage mode, tested-size statement, and limitations disclosure fit without horizontal scrolling.

limitations: Small UI runs did not collect complete process-tree memory or independently decode each output; existing route certification remains separate.
The September 2 browser session ended before final profile-wide storage verification. Prefix-based intermediate cleanup alone does not prove removal of every direct-adapter output.
CLI run-code initially rejected statement syntax; its installed version requires an async function taking page. This was resolved without rerunning completed conversions.
